packageRules.description: Automerge patches and digests (keeps the pinned action SHAs fresh); minor/major reviewed manually.
The integration's pinned lib requirement is bumped by the release workflow, not Renovate.

The HA integration CI job must run whatever Python Home Assistant itself runs (3.13) — testing it on a newer one stops testing what users actually run, and installing HA there fails outright. No datasource maps a package to its supported Python, so Renovate cannot derive this; matched on the value because both jobs live in ci.yml. Raise this when HA moves.
